title: grade.py lists only the metrics of the graded kinds
item: The metric list grade.py prints under the table shows only metrics that apply to the kinds in the table
motivation: Found by the task 28 reviewers: grade.py prints every metric in the grading file, so a build2-only grade lists recall_key, finder_* and other retired-kind metrics. Task 28 makes this longer.
done_means: Grading only build2 trials prints no metric description whose kinds exclude build2; a test covers it.
draft_note: Drafted by the manager on 2026-11-15 from the task 28 reviews. Priority left for the owner.
